hgss1.name: Arcanine
hgss1.effect: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is considered magnificent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.

hgss1.name: Azumarill
hgss1.effect: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

hgss1.name: Clefable
hgss1.effect: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.

hgss1.name: Gyarados
hgss1.effect: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

hgss1.name: Hitmontop
hgss1.effect: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

hgss1.name: Jumpluff
hgss1.effect: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores—it can even float around the world.

hgss1.name: Ninetales
hgss1.effect: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.

hgss1.name: Noctowl
hgss1.effect: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

hgss1.name: Quagsire
hgss1.effect: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

hgss1.name: Raichu
hgss1.effect: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

hgss1.name: Shuckle
hgss1.effect: The berries it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

hgss1.name: Slowking
hgss1.effect: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

hgss1.name: Wobbuffet
hgss1.effect: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

hgss1.name: Ampharos
hgss1.effect: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

hgss1.name: Ariados
hgss1.effect: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

hgss1.name: Butterfree
hgss1.effect: Water-repellent powder on its wings enables it to collect honey, even in the heaviest of rains.

hgss1.name: Cleffa
hgss1.effect: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

hgss1.name: Exeggutor
hgss1.effect: If a head drops off, it emits a telepathic call in search of others to form an Exeggcute cluster.

hgss1.name: Farfetch'd
hgss1.effect: If it eats the plant stalk it carries as emergency rations, it runs off in search of a new stalk.

hgss1.name: Feraligatr
hgss1.effect: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

hgss1.name: Furret
hgss1.effect: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

hgss1.name: Granbull
hgss1.effect: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its bite is powerful.

hgss1.name: Hypno
hgss1.effect: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

hgss1.name: Lapras
hgss1.effect: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.

hgss1.name: Ledian
hgss1.effect: The spot patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

hgss1.name: Meganium
hgss1.effect: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

hgss1.name: Persian
hgss1.effect: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

hgss1.name: Pichu
hgss1.effect: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

hgss1.name: Sandslash
hgss1.effect: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spike and claws. They grow back in a day.

hgss1.name: Smoochum
hgss1.effect: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

hgss1.name: Sunflora
hgss1.effect: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

hgss1.name: Typhlosion
hgss1.effect: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

hgss1.name: Tyrogue
hgss1.effect: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

hgss1.name: Weezing
hgss1.effect: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

hgss1.name: Bayleef
hgss1.effect: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

hgss1.name: Blissey
hgss1.effect: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

hgss1.name: Corsola
hgss1.effect: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

hgss1.name: Croconaw
hgss1.effect: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

hgss1.name: Delibird
hgss1.effect: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

hgss1.name: Donphan
hgss1.effect: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

hgss1.name: Dunsparce
hgss1.effect: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

hgss1.name: Flaaffy
hgss1.effect: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

hgss1.name: Heracross
hgss1.effect: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

hgss1.name: Igglybuff
hgss1.effect: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously—anytime, anywhere.

hgss1.name: Mantine
hgss1.effect: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

hgss1.name: Metapod
hgss1.effect: It prepares for evolution by hardening its shell as much as possible to protect its soft body.

hgss1.name: Miltank
hgss1.effect: If it is around babies, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

hgss1.name: Parasect
hgss1.effect: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.

hgss1.name: Quilava
hgss1.effect: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

hgss1.name: Qwilfish
hgss1.effect: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

hgss1.name: Skiploom
hgss1.effect: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

hgss1.name: Slowbro
hgss1.effect: If the tail-biting Shellder is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary Slowpoke.

hgss1.name: Starmie
hgss1.effect: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.

hgss1.name: Unown
hgss1.effect: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

hgss1.name: Unown
hgss1.effect: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

hgss1.name: Wigglytuff
hgss1.effect: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a Body Slam.

hgss1.name: Caterpie
hgss1.effect: Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.

hgss1.name: Chansey
hgss1.effect: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

hgss1.name: Chikorita
hgss1.effect: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

hgss1.name: Clefairy
hgss1.effect: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

hgss1.name: Cyndaquil
hgss1.effect: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

hgss1.name: Drowzee
hgss1.effect: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

hgss1.name: Exeggcute
hgss1.effect: Using telepathy only they can employ, they always form a cluster of six Exeggcute.

hgss1.name: Girafarig
hgss1.effect: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

hgss1.name: Growlithe
hgss1.effect: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

hgss1.name: Hoothoot
hgss1.effect: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

hgss1.name: Hoppip
hgss1.effect: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.

hgss1.name: Jigglypuff
hgss1.effect: Looking into its cute, round eyes causes it to sing a relaxing melody, inducing its enemies to sleep.

hgss1.name: Jynx
hgss1.effect: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.

hgss1.name: Koffing
hgss1.effect: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

hgss1.name: Ledyba
hgss1.effect: When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

hgss1.name: Magikarp
hgss1.effect: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like Pidgeotto to catch it mid-jump.

hgss1.name: Mareep
hgss1.effect: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

hgss1.name: Marill
hgss1.effect: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

hgss1.name: Meowth
hgss1.effect: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and secretly hoards.

hgss1.name: Paras
hgss1.effect: As its body grows large, large mushrooms named tochukaso start sprouting out of its back.

hgss1.name: Phanpy
hgss1.effect: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

hgss1.name: Pikachu
hgss1.effect: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

hgss1.name: Sandshrew
hgss1.effect: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

hgss1.name: Sentret
hgss1.effect: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

hgss1.name: Slowpoke
hgss1.effect: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

hgss1.name: Snubbull
hgss1.effect: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

hgss1.name: Spinarak
hgss1.effect: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

hgss1.name: Staryu
hgss1.effect: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.

hgss1.name: Sunkern
hgss1.effect: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

hgss1.name: Totodile
hgss1.effect: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

hgss1.name: Vulpix
hgss1.effect: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

hgss1.name: Wooper
hgss1.effect: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

hsp.name: Ho-Oh
hsp.effect: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind when it flies.

hsp.name: Lugia
hsp.effect: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

hsp.name: Pikachu
hsp.effect: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

hsp.name: Wobbuffet
hsp.effect: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

hsp.name: Hoothoot
hsp.effect: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

hsp.name: Noctowl
hsp.effect: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

hsp.name: Latias
hsp.effect: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

hsp.name: Latios
hsp.effect: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

hsp.name: Cleffa
hsp.effect: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

hsp.name: Smoochum
hsp.effect: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

hsp.name: Lapras
hsp.effect: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

hsp.name: Shuckle
hsp.effect: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

hsp.name: Plusle
hsp.effect: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

hsp.name: Minun
hsp.effect: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

hsp.name: Tropical Tidal Wave
hsp.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard all Trainer and Stadium cards your opponent has in play. If tails, discard all Trainer and Stadium cards you have in play.

hsp.name: Raikou
hsp.effect: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

hsp.name: Entei
hsp.effect: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to contain its sheer power, it races headlong around the land.

hsp.name: Suicune
hsp.effect: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

hsp.name: Porygon
hsp.effect: It is a manmade Pokémon. Since it doesn't breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment..

hsp.name: Porygon2
hsp.effect: This upgraded version of Porygon is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

hsp.name: Hitmonchan
hsp.effect: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

hsp.name: Hitmonlee
hsp.effect: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

hgss2.name: Jirachi
hgss2.effect: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

hgss2.name: Magmortar
hgss2.effect: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

hgss2.name: Manaphy
hgss2.effect: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

hgss2.name: Mismagius
hgss2.effect: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

hgss2.name: Octillery
hgss2.effect: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

hgss2.name: Politoed
hgss2.effect: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

hgss2.name: Shaymin
hgss2.effect: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

hgss2.name: Sudowoodo
hgss2.effect: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

hgss2.name: Torterra
hgss2.effect: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

hgss2.name: Xatu
hgss2.effect: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

hgss2.name: Beedrill
hgss2.effect: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

hgss2.name: Blastoise
hgss2.effect: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

hgss2.name: Crobat
hgss2.effect: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

hgss2.name: Fearow
hgss2.effect: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.

hgss2.name: Floatzel
hgss2.effect: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

hgss2.name: Kingdra
hgss2.effect: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

hgss2.name: Lanturn
hgss2.effect: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

hgss2.name: Lucario
hgss2.effect: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras, even foes it could not otherwise see.

hgss2.name: Ninetales
hgss2.effect: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

hgss2.name: Poliwrath
hgss2.effect: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

hgss2.name: Primeape
hgss2.effect: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

hgss2.name: Roserade
hgss2.effect: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

hgss2.name: Steelix
hgss2.effect: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

hgss2.name: Torkoal
hgss2.effect: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

hgss2.name: Tyranitar
hgss2.effect: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It has an insolent nature that makes it not care about others.

hgss2.name: Ursaring
hgss2.effect: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.

hgss2.name: Cherrim
hgss2.effect: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

hgss2.name: Dunsparce
hgss2.effect: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

hgss2.name: Golbat
hgss2.effect: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

hgss2.name: Grotle
hgss2.effect: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

hgss2.name: Kakuna
hgss2.effect: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

hgss2.name: Metang
hgss2.effect: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

hgss2.name: Minun
hgss2.effect: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

hgss2.name: Numel
hgss2.effect: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

hgss2.name: Plusle
hgss2.effect: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

hgss2.name: Poliwhirl
hgss2.effect: The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.

hgss2.name: Pupitar
hgss2.effect: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

hgss2.name: Pupitar
hgss2.effect: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

hgss2.name: Seadra

bw2.effect: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

bw2.name: Leavanny

bw2.name: Cottonee
bw2.effect: They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.

bw2.name: Cottonee
bw2.effect: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

bw2.name: Whimsicott
bw2.effect: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

bw2.name: Whimsicott
bw2.effect: Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokémon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.

bw2.name: Petilil
bw2.effect: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

bw2.name: Lilligant
bw2.effect: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

bw2.name: Deerling
bw2.effect: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

bw2.name: Sawsbuck
bw2.effect: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

bw2.name: Virizion
bw2.effect: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

bw2.name: Pansear

bw2.name: Simisear
bw2.effect: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

bw2.name: Darumaka
bw2.effect: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

bw2.name: Darmanitan

bw2.name: Panpour

bw2.name: Simipour
bw2.effect: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

bw2.name: Basculin

bw2.name: Basculin
bw2.effect: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.

bw2.name: Ducklett
bw2.effect: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

bw2.name: Swanna
bw2.effect: It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.

bw2.name: Cubchoo
bw2.effect: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

bw2.name: Cubchoo
bw2.effect: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

bw2.name: Beartic
bw2.effect: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

bw2.name: Beartic
bw2.effect: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

bw2.name: Emolga
bw2.effect: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membranes and released while it is gliding.

bw2.name: Joltik
bw2.effect: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

bw2.name: Galvantula
bw2.effect: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

bw2.name: Thundurus
bw2.effect: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

bw2.name: Woobat
bw2.effect: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

bw2.name: Swoobat
bw2.effect: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

bw2.name: Venipede
bw2.effect: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

bw2.name: Whirlipede
bw2.effect: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

bw2.name: Scolipede
bw2.effect: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

bw2.name: Sigilyph

bw2.name: Sigilyph
bw2.effect: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

bw2.name: Gothita
bw2.effect: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

bw2.name: Gothita
bw2.effect: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

bw2.name: Gothorita
bw2.effect: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

bw2.name: Gothorita
bw2.effect: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

bw2.name: Gothitelle
bw2.effect: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

bw2.name: Gothitelle
bw2.effect: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.

bw2.name: Roggenrola
bw2.effect: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

bw2.name: Roggenrola
bw2.effect: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

bw2.name: Boldore
bw2.effect: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

bw2.name: Boldore
bw2.effect: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

bw2.name: Gigalith
bw2.effect: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

bw2.name: Drilbur
bw2.effect: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

bw2.name: Drilbur
bw2.effect: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

bw2.name: Excadrill

bw2.name: Excadrill
bw2.effect: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

bw2.name: Throh

bw2.name: Sawk
bw2.effect: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

bw2.name: Sandile
bw2.effect: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

bw2.name: Krokorok
bw2.effect: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

bw2.name: Krookodile
bw2.effect: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

bw2.name: Terrakion
bw2.effect: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

bw2.name: Purrloin
bw2.effect: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

bw2.name: Liepard
bw2.effect: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

bw2.name: Zorua
bw2.effect: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

bw2.name: Zoroark
bw2.effect: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

bw2.name: Vullaby
bw2.effect: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

bw2.name: Mandibuzz
bw2.effect: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

bw2.name: Ferroseed
bw2.effect: They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.

bw2.name: Ferroseed
bw2.effect: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

bw2.name: Ferrothorn
bw2.effect: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

bw2.name: Ferrothorn
bw2.effect: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

bw2.name: Klink
bw2.effect: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

bw2.name: Klang

bw2.name: Klinklang
bw2.effect: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

bw2.name: Cobalion
bw2.effect: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

bw2.name: Patrat
bw2.effect: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

bw2.name: Watchog
bw2.effect: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

bw2.name: Pidove
bw2.effect: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

bw2.name: Tranquill
bw2.effect: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

bw2.name: Unfezant
bw2.effect: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves fell close to anyone other than their Trainers.

bw2.name: Audino
bw2.effect: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radar-like ability to understand its surrounding through slight sounds.

bw2.name: Minccino
bw2.effect: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

bw2.name: Cinccino
bw2.effect: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

bw2.name: Rufflet
bw2.effect: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

bw2.name: Rufflet
bw2.effect: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

bw2.name: Braviary
bw2.effect: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

bw2.name: Tornadus
bw2.effect: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

bw3.effect: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

bw3.name: Lilligant
bw3.effect: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

bw3.name: Dwebble
bw3.effect: The Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

bw3.name: Crustle
bw3.effect: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

bw3.name: Karrablast
bw3.effect: When they feel threatened, they spit acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.

bw3.name: Foongus

bw3.name: Amoonguss
bw3.effect: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

bw3.name: Shelmet
bw3.effect: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.

bw3.name: Accelgor
bw3.effect: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

bw3.name: Virizion
bw3.effect: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

bw3.effect: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

bw3.effect: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

bw3.name: Larvesta
bw3.effect: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

bw3.name: Larvesta
bw3.effect: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

bw3.name: Volcarona
bw3.effect: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

bw3.name: Tympole
bw3.effect: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

bw3.name: Palpitoad
bw3.effect: It lives in water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

bw3.name: Seismitoad
bw3.effect: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

bw3.name: Tirtouga
bw3.effect: Put this card onto your Bench only with the effect of Cover Fossil

bw3.name: Carracosta
bw3.effect: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

bw3.name: Vanillite
bw3.effect: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

bw3.name: Vanillish
bw3.effect: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.

bw3.name: Vanilluxe
bw3.effect: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

bw3.name: Frillish
bw3.effect: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

bw3.name: Jellicent
bw3.effect: The fate of ships and crew that wander into Jellicent's habitats: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

bw3.name: Cryogonal
bw3.effect: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

bw3.name: Cryogonal

bw3.name: Kyurem
bw3.effect: It generates powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

bw3.name: Blitzle
bw3.effect: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

bw3.name: Zebstrika
bw3.effect: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

bw3.name: Emolga
bw3.effect: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

bw3.name: Tynamo
bw3.effect: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

bw3.name: Tynamo
bw3.effect: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

bw3.name: Eelektrik
bw3.effect: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

bw3.name: Eelektross
bw3.effect: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

bw3.name: Stunfisk
bw3.effect: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

bw3.name: Victini
bw3.effect: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

bw3.name: Yamask
bw3.effect: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

bw3.name: Yamask
bw3.effect: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

bw3.name: Cofagrigus
bw3.effect: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

bw3.name: Cofagrigus
bw3.effect: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

bw3.name: Trubbish
bw3.effect: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

bw3.name: Garbodor
bw3.effect: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

bw3.name: Solosis
bw3.effect: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

bw3.name: Duosion
bw3.effect: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

bw3.name: Reuniclus
bw3.effect: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

bw3.name: Reuniclus
bw3.effect: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

bw3.name: Elgyem
bw3.effect: This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.

bw3.name: Elgyem
bw3.effect: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

bw3.name: Beheeyem
bw3.effect: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

bw3.name: Litwick
bw3.effect: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel it burns.

bw3.name: Litwick
bw3.effect: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leaches off the life force of any who follow it.

bw3.name: Lampent
bw3.effect: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

bw3.name: Chandelure
bw3.effect: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

bw3.name: Gigalith
bw3.effect: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

bw3.name: Timburr
bw3.effect: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

bw3.name: Gurdurr
bw3.effect: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

bw3.name: Conkeldurr

bw3.name: Conkeldurr
bw3.effect: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

bw3.name: Archen

bw3.name: Archeops

bw3.name: Stunfisk
bw3.effect: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a volt of electricity.

bw3.name: Mienfoo
bw3.effect: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attack. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

bw3.name: Mienshao
bw3.effect: It wield the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arms attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

bw3.name: Golett
bw3.effect: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.

bw3.name: Golurk
bw3.effect: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

bw3.name: Terrakion
bw3.effect: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

bw3.name: Landorus
bw3.effect: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

bw3.name: Pawniard
bw3.effect: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

bw3.name: Bisharp
bw3.effect: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

bw3.name: Deino

bw3.name: Zweilous
bw3.effect: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

bw3.name: Hydreigon
bw3.effect: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

bw3.name: Pawniard
bw3.effect: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

bw3.name: Durant

bw3.name: Cobalion

bw3.name: Audino

bw3.name: Axew

bw3.name: Fraxure

bw3.name: Haxorus

bw3.name: Druddigon
bw3.effect: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

bw7.name: Bellossom
bw7.effect: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

bw7.name: Tangela
bw7.effect: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

bw7.name: Tangrowth
bw7.effect: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

bw7.name: Scyther
bw7.effect: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

bw7.name: Heracross
bw7.effect: No matter how heavy its opponents, it flings them far away with its prized horn.

bw7.name: Celebi-EX
bw7.effect: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

bw7.name: Shaymin
bw7.effect: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

bw7.name: Snivy
bw7.effect: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

bw7.name: Servine
bw7.effect: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

bw7.name: Serperior
bw7.effect: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

bw7.name: Cottonee
bw7.effect: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

bw7.name: Whimsicott
bw7.effect: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.

bw7.name: Petilil
bw7.effect: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

bw7.name: Lilligant
bw7.effect: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

bw7.name: Charmander
bw7.effect: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

bw7.name: Charmeleon
bw7.effect: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

bw7.name: Charizard
bw7.effect: It is said that Charizard's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

bw7.name: Numel
bw7.effect: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees F. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

bw7.name: Camerupt
bw7.effect: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years–or whenever it becomes really angry.

bw7.name: Victini
bw7.effect: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

bw7.name: Tepig
bw7.effect: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

bw7.name: Pignite
bw7.effect: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

bw7.name: Emboar
bw7.effect: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

bw7.name: Darumaka
bw7.effect: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 F.

bw7.name: Darmanitan
bw7.effect: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

bw7.name: Squirtle
bw7.effect: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

bw7.name: Wartortle
bw7.effect: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

bw7.name: Blastoise
bw7.effect: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

bw7.name: Psyduck
bw7.effect: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

bw7.name: Psyduck
bw7.effect: When headaches stimulate its brain cells, which are usually inactive, it can use a mysterious power.

bw7.name: Golduck
bw7.effect: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

bw7.name: Golduck
bw7.effect: When its forehead shines mysteriously, Golduck can use the full extent of its power.

bw7.name: Marill
bw7.effect: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it's fine even in rivers with strong currents.

bw7.name: Azumarill
bw7.effect: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

bw7.name: Delibird
bw7.effect: It carries food all day long. When someone is lost in the mountains, it shares that food.

bw7.name: Oshawott
bw7.effect: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

bw7.name: Dewott
bw7.effect: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

bw7.name: Samurott
bw7.effect: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

bw7.name: Ducklett
bw7.effect: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

bw7.name: Swanna
bw7.effect: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

bw7.name: Frillish
bw7.effect: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

bw7.name: Jellicent
bw7.effect: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

bw7.name: Cryogonal
bw7.effect: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

bw7.name: Keldeo
bw7.effect: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

bw7.name: Keldeo
bw7.effect: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

bw7.name: Keldeo-EX
bw7.effect: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

bw7.name: Pikachu
bw7.effect: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

bw7.name: Voltorb
bw7.effect: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on contact.

bw7.name: Electrode
bw7.effect: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

bw7.name: Electabuzz
bw7.effect: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

bw7.name: Electivire
bw7.effect: The instant it presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent, it sends over 20,000 volts of electricity into the foe.

bw7.name: Chinchou
bw7.effect: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

bw7.name: Blitzle
bw7.effect: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

bw7.name: Zebstrika
bw7.effect: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

bw7.name: Wobbuffet
bw7.effect: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

bw7.name: Spoink
bw7.effect: Using its tail like a spring, it keeps its heart beating by bouncing constantly. If it stops, it dies.

bw7.name: Grumpig
bw7.effect: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

bw7.name: Duskull
bw7.effect: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.

bw7.name: Dusclops
bw7.effect: It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

bw7.name: Dusknoir
bw7.effect: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

bw7.name: Croagunk
bw7.effect: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

bw7.name: Croagunk
bw7.effect: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

bw7.name: Toxicroak
bw7.effect: The croaking that Toxicroak produces before a battle is for churning the poison it has stored in its poison sac.

bw7.name: Cresselia-EX
bw7.effect: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

bw7.name: Munna
bw7.effect: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

bw7.name: Musharna
bw7.effect: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

bw7.name: Woobat
bw7.effect: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

bw7.name: Swoobat
bw7.effect: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

bw7.name: Venipede
bw7.effect: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey's location and state.

bw7.name: Whirlipede
bw7.effect: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But, when predators approach, it moves to stab them with poison spikes.

bw7.name: Scolipede
bw7.effect: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

bw7.name: Gothita
bw7.effect: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

bw7.name: Gothorita
bw7.effect: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

bw7.name: Meloetta
bw7.effect: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

bw7.name: Sandshrew
bw7.effect: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.

bw7.name: Sandslash
bw7.effect: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.

bw7.name: Gligar
bw7.effect: It clamps on to its chosen prey then jabs the stinger on its tail into the prey while it's stunned with surprise.

bw7.name: Gliscor
bw7.effect: It dances silently through the sky. When it approaches prey, it can land a critical hit in an instant.

bw7.name: Makuhita
bw7.effect: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

bw7.name: Trapinch
bw7.effect: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

bw7.name: Dwebble
bw7.effect: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.

bw7.name: Crustle
bw7.effect: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.

bw7.name: Mienfoo
bw7.effect: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

bw7.name: Mienfoo
bw7.effect: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

bw7.name: Mienshao
bw7.effect: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.

bw7.name: Landorus-EX
bw7.effect: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

bw7.name: Purrloin
bw7.effect: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

bw7.name: Liepard
bw7.effect: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

bw7.name: Vullaby
bw7.effect: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

bw7.name: Mandibuzz
bw7.effect: It makes a nest out of the bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

bw7.name: Scizor
bw7.effect: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.

bw7.name: Skarmory
bw7.effect: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speed of over 180 mph.

bw7.name: Skarmory
bw7.effect: Its heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

bw7.name: Klink
bw7.effect: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

bw7.name: Vibrava
bw7.effect: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

bw7.name: Flygon
bw7.effect: Known as "The Desert Spirit" this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

bw7.name: Black Kyurem
bw7.effect: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

bw7.name: Black Kyurem-EX
bw7.effect: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

bw7.name: White Kyurem
bw7.effect: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

bw7.name: White Kyurem-EX
bw7.effect: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

bw7.name: Rattata
bw7.effect: It searches for food all day. It gnaws on hard objects to wear down its fangs, which grow constantly during its lifetime.

bw7.name: Raticate
bw7.effect: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokémon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.

bw7.name: Meowth
bw7.effect: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

bw7.name: Farfetch'd
bw7.effect: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

bw7.name: Ditto
bw7.effect: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

bw7.name: Snorlax
bw7.effect: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

bw7.name: Togepi
bw7.effect: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.

bw7.name: Dunsparce
bw7.effect: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

bw7.name: Taillow
bw7.effect: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

bw7.name: Skitty
bw7.effect: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

bw7.name: Delcatty
bw7.effect: The reason it does not have a nest is that it simply searches for a clean, comfortable place then sleeps there.

bw7.name: Spinda
bw7.effect: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

bw7.name: Buneary
bw7.effect: By extending its rolled up ears and striking the ground, it can bound so high it surprises itself.

bw7.name: Lopunny
bw7.effect: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

bw7.name: Patrat
bw7.effect: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

bw7.name: Watchog
bw7.effect: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

bw7.name: Lillipup
bw7.effect: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it's also smart enough to check its foe's strength and avoid battle.

bw7.name: Herdier
bw7.effect: This very loyal Pokémon helps trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

bw7.name: Stoutland
bw7.effect: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.

bw7.name: Pidove
bw7.effect: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

bw7.name: Tranquill
bw7.effect: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.

bw7.name: Unfezant
bw7.effect: Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.

bw7.name: Audino
bw7.effect: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

bw7.name: Aspertia City Gym
bw7.effect: Each Colorless Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets +20 HP. This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

bw7.effect: Each player either draws or discard cards until he or she has 5 cards in his or her hand. (Your opponent does this first.) You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).
